content: Paulo ꞌina ꞌadau Loma manuna

Ta niꞌatu siloina ꞌaene Itali ꞌena ꞌada tauya, ꞌenega Paulo be ꞌaina yoniyonidi wate maꞌenao siꞌebwayaedi Sisa ꞌina tolosaiyao ꞌadi toanugana ꞌenaya, ꞌana esana Yuliasi, be ꞌima ꞌadau ꞌena ꞌiꞌitaꞌiꞌisidi.
Ga Adilamitio ꞌenega wagega ꞌagelu, tauna waga nina ꞌiabe ꞌipipili Esia leꞌawina ꞌasanao ꞌediya, ga ꞌatupa, Alisitako maꞌemai, tauna goma Masidoniana, sena Tesalonaika ꞌenega.
Ta tomwa ꞌiulisina ga Saidoni ꞌena ꞌalugu, ta Yuliasi Paulo ꞌiꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyena ga ꞌitagwalena ga ꞌitauya gosenao ꞌediya, be sida ꞌitaꞌiꞌisina.
Ta Saidoniyega ꞌatupa limana ga Saipilosi gwaunega ꞌapili sakowasi, manuna Saipilosi matanega yagila ꞌilodebedebema.
Ta niꞌatu Silisia be Pamipili olanao ꞌapilisinedi, ga Maila ꞌalugu, sena Lisia ꞌenaya.
Gote ꞌena tolosaiyao ꞌadi toanugana nina ꞌebweu Alekisanidela wagana ꞌilobena, ꞌiabe ꞌitutupa Itali manuna, ga ꞌena ꞌagelubala.

Ta ꞌasiyata yauna ꞌima ꞌadau mwauna, ga Nidasi ꞌaloselabena, ta nigeya sawesawenaya be Nidasi matanega ꞌapalumo, manuna yagila sinabwana matamega, ꞌenega ꞌamwaꞌuta Kiliti be Salimone gamwagamwanidiyega ꞌasola, ga Kiliti gwaunega ꞌasakowasi.
Ta dabalega ꞌatupa, ta yagila nina tuga ꞌiꞌewaꞌewaema ga ꞌamai gomwagomwa ꞌebweu ꞌana esana Gomwagomwa Siwalowa ꞌena, ꞌasa Lasia leꞌawinaya.
Ta tuta dudulana niꞌatu ꞌamudalina, ga ꞌEbotana ꞌana tuta ꞌigumwala, ga yagila ꞌana tuta toꞌumalina niꞌatu ꞌieꞌale, ꞌenega Paulo ꞌiemataluwedi,

ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwanao, ꞌilobwenena be tada eyawaiꞌata gomwagomwa gete ꞌena. Geyaꞌabo tatootoo be taꞌadaꞌadau limana, ꞌabona nai taesilae, be gwegwe be waga tamudalidi, be nai ꞌaboꞌada watei tamwamwawasa.”
Ta tolosaiyao ꞌadi toanugana toniwaga be waga ꞌana topwalowa ꞌenadi ꞌinonodi, ta nigeya Paulo ꞌina ona manuna ꞌinuwanuwa.

Ta gomwagomwa nina nigeya ꞌilobwelobwene bolimana ꞌana tutaya, ta yaudi siona, “Tatoo tuga, be ꞌabo kapekapeyana Pinikisa ꞌena talulugu, manuna tauna gomwagomwa boboꞌana, be ꞌenaya taeyawaiꞌata.” Ta Pinikisa nina gomwagomwana salu Kiliti ꞌenaya, ta ꞌawana yalasi be yaalata ꞌiloꞌawasidi.
Wediliya silobena
Ta niꞌatu yalasi gidalina ꞌitowama, ga sinuwena ꞌaene ꞌiabe siꞌadau boboꞌana be Pinikisa sida lugu, ꞌenega loomu sikwalina ga Kiliti selabenega sipili dabalega.
Ta tuta gidalina ga yagila tosinabwa sana, ꞌana esana Lagasai, ꞌitowadoloma,
ga waga nigeya sawesawenaya be ꞌisasasa, manuna yagila matamega ꞌitowatowama, ꞌenega tuga ꞌadamomo,
ta salu gidalina ꞌana esana Kiloda gwaunega ꞌatupatupa, ta ꞌaewaiwai ga waga ꞌebe talaesuya ꞌalisi tuꞌeyena,
ta balae siꞌewedi ga waga sididina, ta simatauta, nai kaukau ꞌana esana Silitisa ꞌena situtula, ga ꞌenega naya sipelena ta ꞌadoedoema tuga.
Ta wediliya sinabwana waga ꞌiꞌauꞌau bunibuni wawasae, ta tomwa ꞌiulisina ga waga ꞌana eusana sieula mwaꞌutedi.
Ta ꞌasiyata ꞌetonina ꞌena waga ꞌana gwegweyao siꞌewedi ga sieula mwaꞌutedi.
Ta ꞌasiyata yauna ꞌediya nigeya sinala nai kwadima ꞌada ꞌitedi, ta wediliya sinabwana ꞌimutumutuma, ꞌenega ꞌamwalatonina ꞌaene ꞌiabe ꞌamwamwawasa.

Ta niꞌatu ꞌasiyata yauna waga ꞌana togeluyao nigeya siꞌeꞌai, ga Paulo gamwagamwanidiya ꞌitoolo, ta ꞌigwae, “Tasigwao, ꞌabo ꞌigu ona wada nononaya, be geyaꞌabo Kilitiyega tada gelugeluma, geyaꞌabo saꞌi mwau be esilae gete tada lobaloba.
Ta gete yaguguyami, wada ꞌatepatu, geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu ꞌemiyega ꞌimwamwawasa, ta waga namo esiya ꞌiabe ꞌidadamana,
manuna guluwanai ꞌigu Yaubada nina, tauna yaemisena, ꞌina anilose ꞌimai ga selabeguya ꞌitoolo,
ta ꞌieonegu, ‘Paulo, geyaꞌabo ꞌumatamatauta; ꞌiabe Sisa matanaya ꞌuda toolo, manuna ꞌimu sidasida ꞌenega waga ꞌana togeluyao maiboꞌadi maꞌemwao Yaubada ꞌida ꞌetoseyemi.’
ꞌEnega tasigwao, geyaꞌabo wamatamatauta, manuna Yaubada yaemisena be ꞌiabe ꞌida guinuwa nadigega tuga ꞌieꞌitegu.
Ta ꞌiabe salu ꞌebweu ꞌena tatutula.”
Waga ꞌitula
Wiki ꞌeluwa sigumwala, ꞌetamo saꞌi Edilia bwagabwaganaya ꞌadoedoe dadanema, ta niuniuwanaya waga ꞌana topaisewao sinuwena ꞌaene dabala ꞌaloseloselabe.
ꞌEnega niꞌu siulatootoona ga silobena ꞌana mwaꞌuta nadigega tuweniti lowa ꞌana dudula. Ta tupwana ꞌadoenao ga wate siulatoona ga silobena niꞌu ꞌana mwaꞌuta nadigega pipitini lowa.
Ta simatauta geyaꞌabo be gulewa ꞌena ꞌatutula, ga waga kuliginega loomu ata siuledi, ta sisidasida tomwa manuna be ꞌida ulisi manini.
Ta ꞌaina waga nina ꞌana topaisewao nuwanuwadi be wagega sida dena, ga waga ꞌebe talaesuya sipelena niꞌuya, ta sikabo ꞌaene loomu wate sida ule waga matanega.
Ga Paulo tolosaiyao ma ꞌadi toanugana ꞌieonedi, “ꞌAbo tomota gotedi wagega sidedena, geyaꞌabo saꞌi taboboboꞌana.”
ꞌEnega tolosaiyao nidi waga ꞌebe talaesuya ꞌana balaeyao siꞌupwa yauledi ga ꞌidoena.
Ta niꞌatu tomwa ꞌiabe be ꞌiulisi, ga Paulo ꞌieonedi be sida ꞌeꞌai, ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu ꞌasiyata potini ꞌatesaꞌala manuna ga nigeya wate ꞌeꞌai wada lotoona.
ꞌEnega ꞌilobweneda be tada loepaꞌala, manuna geyaꞌabo saꞌi ꞌebweu ꞌiesiesilae.”
Ta niꞌatu ꞌiona ga beledi ꞌiꞌewena ta manuna ꞌilokagutoki Yaubada ꞌena, maiboꞌama matamaya, ga ꞌigitomwena, ga tauna ꞌigimiꞌai.
Ta ꞌenega maiboꞌama nuwama ꞌiboboꞌana, ga ꞌaꞌeꞌai watei.
Ta ꞌama yau waga nina ꞌena ꞌagelu nate tu analedi be sebeniti sikisi.
Ga niꞌatu gamwama ꞌipawa, ga witi waga solanega siulena niꞌuya, be ꞌaene waga ꞌida kapekapeyana.
Ta tomwa niꞌatu ꞌiulisina ga dabala siꞌitena, ta nigeya siꞌinaꞌinane to ꞌasa, ta gomwagomwa makaukauna siꞌitalobena, ꞌenega sinuwanuwa ꞌabo kapekapeyana waga nina silagaei dabalaya.
ꞌEnega loomu siꞌupwa yauledi ga niꞌuya sigisinedi, ta wate pwalowa ꞌana balaeyao siliꞌamidi be sipwapwalowa, ta naya nuganaya silisi tuꞌeyena be situtupa dabala nina manuna.
Ta malolo ꞌiꞌausepalema ga waga ꞌaetulaena kaukau lodabadabalina ꞌena, ga waga ꞌubusuna ꞌitula ta nigeya sawesawenaya be ꞌiloniu, ta kuligina lisu ꞌidi lasapeꞌopeꞌoega ꞌiepisalina.
Ta ꞌenega tolosaiyao sinuwanuwa ga ꞌaene yoniyonidi sida loemwawasidi, ꞌabona nai ꞌaidi sida tubeꞌoyaꞌa dabalaya be sidedena.

Ta ꞌadi toanugana nina nuwanuwana be Paulo ꞌiꞌetoseyei, ꞌenega ꞌiꞌetobodedi, ꞌaene geyaꞌabo siloeloemwawasidi. Ta esiya ꞌiloinedi taudi sawesawediya be situtube sida ꞌatui nugana be dabala manuna sida tube,
be ꞌenega tupwa mamo waga senasenamidiyega ꞌatubelaga. ꞌEnega maiboꞌama niꞌatu ma ima boboꞌana ꞌatubeꞌoyaꞌa dabalaya.
